title: Vigil bu ñi ñàkk seen mbokk
intro: Yaa ngi waaja daje ak xol buy natt ci tàqaloo bu gëna xóot, xol bu xam làkku rangooñ waaye xolam musul ñàkk yaakaar. Ci jaar-jaaru njuuj njaaj, bëgg-bëgg, ak mujjentalu dajewaat, jaamub Yàlla bu tedd bii dafa doon misaalu muñ ba fàww. Kan moo muñ ay at yu metti yu nëbbu, ba noppi gis ak bànneex ci saasi?
clues: Man yonent laa bu turam nekkoon luy màndargaal muñ ci kanamu ñàkk gu rëy.
Barkeel nañu ma doom yu góor yu bari, waaye fiiraange gi ñeneen ñi jële ma ci benn.
Mbëggeel gi ma am ci ki réer dafa xóot ba samay bët weex ndax naqar, waaye musu ma ñaxtu ludul ci Yàlla.
Ma yónnee samay doom ñu dellu seet ki ma réer ak rakkam, di leen digal ñu baña xàddi.
Bi kiy yóbbaale xibaar bu baax bi yegsee, ñu laxas sama kanam benn chemise, ci saasi àdduna bi leeraat.
Ñu xamee ma ci Israyil, te ci sama fukk ak ñaari doom la fukk ak ñaari xeeti réew mu mag juddoo.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Tàqaloo ak doom ju baax ci ay at yu bari
ñu sànni leen ci safara gu tàng
Dafa am feebaru der bu metti
trial.answer: Tàqaloo ak doom ju baax ci ay at yu bari

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Dafa mujjee gis, mu dajewaat ak doomam
Dañu may ndam ci kaw buur buy jaay doole
Ñu dekkal ko ci asamaan si di dundu
Ñu fal ko mu yor Egypt
Jox nañu ko doom bu góor ci màgget, muy kéemtaanu
outcome.answer: Dafa mujjee gis, mu dajewaat ak doomam

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
